title: F4R: Failure-Driven Recognition, Reconstruction, Refinement, and Redeployment for Continual Robot Self-Improvement
title_zh: F4R: 失败驱动的实到仿真再到实的闭环学习框架

paragraphs.en: The real-world performance of current vision-language-action models is fundamentally constrained by the limited coverage of expert demonstrations and their insufficient understanding of physical interactions. A common remedy is to collect additional real-world demonstrations of newly encountered failures. However, this process is costly, inefficient, potentially unsafe, and difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose Failure for Rising ( F4R ), a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real closed-loop learning framework that converts real-world failures into targeted policy improvement. F4R first uses an agent to automatically identify and diagnose failures from rollouts. It reconstructs each failure as an interactive, object-centric table-top environment that preserves the task-relevant spatial and physical conditions. The policy is then refined through failure-conditioned sim-real co-training followed by targeted reinforcement learning in the reconstructed environments. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed, while newly observed failures are continuously fed back into the next reconstruction and learning cycle. Real-world evaluations on four manipulation tasks show that F4R achieves 93.75% In-Distribution and 90.0% Out-of-Distribution (OOD) success, outperforming the budget-matched Targeted BC baseline by 18.75 percentage points under OOD conditions without collecting additional real-world corrective demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 当前视觉-语言-动作模型在真实世界中的表现，根本上受到专家演示覆盖范围有限以及对物理交互理解不足的限制。 一种常见的解决方案是收集针对新出现的失败情况的更多真实世界演示数据。 然而，这一过程成本高昂、效率低下、可能存在安全隐患，且难以扩展。 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 Failure for Rising（F4R）——一个以失败驱动的真实到模拟再到真实的闭环学习框架，能够将真实世界的失败转化为策略的针对性改进。 F4R 首先通过智能体自动识别并诊断执行过程中的失败情况。 它会将每次失败重构为一个交互式、以物体为中心的实验台环境，从而保留任务相关的空间与物理条件。 随后，策略会通过基于失败条件的模拟-真实联合训练进行优化，并在重构后的环境中进行针对性强化学习。 改进后的策略会被重新部署，同时新观察到的失败会持续反馈到下一轮的重构与学习循环中。 在四个操作任务上的真实世界评估表明，F4R 实现了 93.75% 的分布内成功率和 90.0% 的分布外（OOD）成功率，在 OOD 条件下无需收集额外的真实世界纠正性演示，便比预算相当的 Targeted BC 基线模型高出 18.75 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Recent advances in robot learning have substantially expanded robots’ ability to perform diverse manipulation tasks. Modern vision-language-action models are trained on large and diverse demonstration datasets ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2024 ) . This scale enables them to learn broad visuomotor priors and generalize across tasks, objects, scenes, and robot embodiments. Nevertheless, strong performance on established benchmarks does not necessarily translate into reliable real-world deployment. Current policies remain brittle under Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) settings, e.g., unfamiliar object configurations, changes in camera viewpoint or robot initialization, and the presence of distracting objects or visual clutter ( Fei et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) . Such variations can silently disrupt perception, spatial reasoning, and closed-loop action execution, ultimately leading to task failures. More importantly, these failures tend to arise in long-tailed scenarios that are underrepresented or even entirely absent in the original training data, exposing a persistent gap between training data and real-world conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人学习领域的最新进展显著提升了机器人执行多样化操作任务的能力。 现代视觉-语言-动作模型是在大规模且多样化的演示数据集上进行训练的（Kim et al., 2025；Black et al., 2024）。 这种规模使其能够学习广泛的视觉运动先验，并在不同任务、物体、场景和机器人形态之间实现泛化。 然而，在既定基准测试中的优异表现并不必然意味着能够在真实世界中可靠部署。 当前策略在分布外（OOD）设置下仍然脆弱，例如面对不熟悉的物体配置、摄像头视角或机器人初始化的变化，以及干扰性物体或视觉杂乱的存在（Fei et al., 2026；Lee et al., 2025）。 此类变化可能悄无声息地破坏感知、空间推理和闭环动作执行，最终导致任务失败。 更重要的是，这些失败往往出现在长尾场景中，而这些场景在原始训练数据中要么代表性不足，甚至完全缺失，暴露出训练数据与真实世界条件之间持续存在的差距。

paragraphs.en: A straightforward way to improve coverage of long-tail scenarios is to collect more diverse real-world demonstrations. However, real-world data collection requires substantial human effort, hardware resources, and operational coordination, making it impractical to exhaustively capture rare failure cases ( Khazatsky et al., 2024 ) . The real-to-sim-to-real paradigm offers a more scalable alternative by using real-world data to construct simulation environments, where tasks, scenes, and initial conditions can be systematically diversified for policy improvement ( Mandlekar et al., 2023 ; Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 提高长尾场景覆盖范围的一个直接方法，是收集更多样化的真实世界演示数据。 然而，真实世界的数据收集需要大量人力、硬件资源和操作协调，因此要穷尽地捕捉罕见故障案例是不切实际的（Khazatsky 等人，2024）。 “真实-模拟-真实”范式提供了一种更具扩展性的替代方案：利用真实世界数据构建模拟环境，从而能够系统性地多样化任务、场景和初始条件，以改进策略（Mandlekar 等人，2023；Nasiriany 等人，2024）。

paragraphs.en: However, the effectiveness of real-to-sim-to-real learning depends on how the simulation environments are constructed. Manually designed scenarios or broad randomization may increase diversity, but they are not necessarily aligned with the failure distribution encountered in real-world deployment ( Lin et al., 2026 ) . As a result, the added diversity may improve overall performance, yet it does not necessarily provide targeted supervision signals for the recurring failure modes observed during real-world deployment. Our key insight is that each real-world failure identifies a specific set of conditions under which the current policy lacks robustness. Reconstructing these conditions in interactive simulation turns each real-world failure into a targeted and reusable training scenario, allowing the robot to revisit hard cases and explore corrective behaviors without collecting additional costly and unsafe real-world demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，从真实到模拟再到真实的迁移学习的有效性取决于模拟环境的构建方式。 手动设计的场景或广泛的随机化或许能提升多样性，但它们未必与真实世界部署中可能遇到的故障分布一致（Lin et al., 2026）。 因此，这种新增的多样性虽然可能提升整体性能，但未必能为真实世界部署中反复出现的故障模式提供有针对性的监督信号。 我们的核心洞见是：每一次真实世界的故障都揭示了一组特定的条件，在这些条件下，当前策略缺乏鲁棒性。 在交互式模拟中重建这些条件，能将每一次真实世界的故障转化为一个有针对性且可重复使用的训练场景，使机器人能够重新挑战困难案例并探索纠正行为，而无需收集额外的高成本且存在安全隐患的真实世界演示数据。

paragraphs.en: Building on this insight, we propose F4R , a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real framework that iteratively refines robot policies using failures observed during deployment. F4R employs a Vision-Language Model (VLM)-based diagnostic agent to identify failed executions and infer their underlying causes from deployment videos, and then reconstructs the corresponding objects and spatial configurations in interactive simulation. Since each reconstructed scene captures only one instance of a failure mode, F4R applies failure-aware randomization to generate a diverse set of failure-relevant configurations around the reconstructed scene. Using successful real-world demonstrations as seeds, F4R uses MimicGen to adapt their object-centric motion segments to the randomized reconstructed scenes and retains successful simulated rollouts for sim-real co-training. Following sim-real co-training, F4R further refines the policy through targeted reinforcement learning in the same environments before redeployment, allowing newly observed failures to drive subsequent refinement cycles. With this iterative refinement process, F4R achieves a 90.0% OOD success rate, outperforming the budget-matched Targeted BC baseline by 18.75 percentage points without additional real-world corrective demonstrations.

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We develop a failure-guided reconstruction pipeline that converts real-world failures into geometrically consistent, photorealistic, and interactive simulation environments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一种以故障为导向的重建流程，该流程可将现实世界中的故障转化为几何结构一致、照片级真实且可交互的模拟环境。

paragraphs.en: We propose a two-stage refinement strategy that combines failure-relevant sim-real co-training with targeted reinforcement learning, allowing newly observed failures to drive subsequent refinement cycles.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种两阶段优化策略，该策略将故障相关的仿真-现实协同训练与目标强化学习相结合，使新观察到的故障能够驱动后续的优化循环。

paragraphs.en: The components are integrated into F4R, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that iteratively turns real-world failures into reusable training assets. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness in policy improvement without additional real-world corrective demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 这些组件被整合到 F4R 中，这是一个从真实世界到模拟再到真实世界的框架，能够迭代地将现实中的失败转化为可重复使用的训练资源。 大量实验证明，该框架无需额外的现实世界纠正性演示，即可有效改进策略。

paragraphs.en: Grounding simulation environments in real-world observations provides a promising approach to narrowing the sim-to-real gap. RialTo ( Torne Villasevil et al., 2024 ) reconstructs digital twins from real-world scans for RL-based policy adaptation. Recent studies increasingly leverage 3D Gaussian Splatting to improve visual fidelity. RL-GSBridge ( Wu et al., 2025 ) couples Gaussian representations with simulation meshes, while RoboGSim ( Li et al., 2025 ) and GS-Playground ( Jia et al., 2026 ) integrate scene reconstruction, composition, physics, and data generation. RoboSplat ( Yang et al., 2025 ) enables scene editing for data diversification, whereas EmbodieDreamer ( Wang et al., 2025 ) and RoboSimGS ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) further improve visual and physical alignment. In parallel, URDFormer ( Chen et al., 2024b ) and Scalable Real2Sim ( Pfaff et al., 2025 ) automate the recovery of simulation-ready geometry and physical properties.

paragraphs.en: Most existing pipelines, however, remain scene- or task-driven: the target environment is typically selected independently of the policy’s observed deployment failures. Consequently, the generated simulation data may increase overall diversity but are not explicitly concentrated on the hardest conditions under which the deployed policy is least robust. In contrast, F4R uses deployment failures to determine both what should be reconstructed and how each reconstructed scene should be expanded, thereby forming a failure-centered training distribution for targeted policy refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，大多数现有的流程仍然以场景或任务为导向：目标环境通常独立于策略所观察到的部署失败而选择。 因此，生成的模拟数据虽然可能提升整体多样性，但并未明确聚焦于已部署策略最缺乏鲁棒性的那些最困难的条件。 相比之下，F4R 利用部署失败来确定哪些内容需要重建以及每个重建场景应如何扩展，从而形成以失败为中心的训练分布，用于针对策略的优化改进。

paragraphs.en: Supervised fine-tuning is widely used to adapt generalist robot policies, but its performance is constrained by the coverage of available demonstrations. Sim-Real Co-training ( Maddukuri et al., 2025 ) broadens this coverage by jointly training on real and simulated data, while task-relevant representation alignment improves cross-domain transfer ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) . Nevertheless, these approaches still rely on simulated demonstrations that sufficiently cover deployment-relevant conditions.

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning complements supervised training by improving policies through interaction. ReinboT ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) introduces return maximization into offline VLA training, while ConRFT ( Chen et al., 2025 ) combines offline value learning with online refinement. SimpleVLA-RL ( Li et al., 2026 ) scales outcome-based online RL through VLA-specific sampling and parallel interaction, and ReinFlow ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and FPO ( Lyu et al., 2026 ) extend RL to flow-based policies. RLinf-Co ( Shi et al., 2026 ) combines sim-real co-training with simulation RL and real-data supervision. However, these methods generally optimize over predefined distributions rather than using deployment failures to determine where refinement is most needed.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习通过交互改进策略，从而对监督训练形成补充。 ReinboT（Zhang 等人，2025）将回报最大化引入离线 VLA 训练，而 ConRFT（Chen 等人，2025）则将离线价值学习与在线优化相结合。 SimpleVLA-RL（Li 等人，2026）通过针对 VLA 的采样和并行交互，扩展了基于结果的在线强化学习；ReinFlow（Zhang 等人，2026）和 FPO（Lyu 等人，2026）则将强化学习推广到了基于流的策略。 RLinf-Co（Shi 等人，2026）将模拟-现实协同训练与模拟强化学习和真实数据监督相结合。 然而，这些方法通常是在预定义分布上进行优化，而不是利用部署中的失败情况来确定何处最需要优化。

paragraphs.en: Recent systems exploit execution feedback more explicitly. ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026 ) diagnoses failures and repairs code-as-policy programs, consolidating validated solutions into a reusable skill library. TwinRL ( Xu et al., 2026 ) reconstructs a workspace-level digital twin to expand SFT coverage, initialize simulation RL, and guide human-in-the-loop real-world refinement. In contrast, F4R uses deployment failures to jointly determine what should be reconstructed and where training should be concentrated, forming a closed loop that converts newly observed failures into reusable simulation environments and targeted policy updates.

paragraphs.en: F4R is an iterative real-to-sim-to-real framework that turns real-world failures into reusable training assets. paragraphs.en: We evaluate F4R through simulation and real-world experiments. Our evaluation addresses five questions. (1) Can F4R improve real-world performance on observed deployment failures? (2) Do the reconstructed environments preserve task-relevant behavioral difficulty and reduce real data requirements? (3) Does F4R generalize across different failure-inducing variations? paragraphs.en: We evaluate our method on eight tabletop manipulation tasks (Figure 3 ) by comparing binary success rates. Four representative tasks are further selected for policy-refinement experiments. We define the In-Distribution (ID) setting as task configurations covered by the original data-collection distribution, and the Out-of-Distribution (OOD) setting as deployment failure conditions absent from that distribution. Real-world performance is measured over 20 trials in each setting, while simulation performance is evaluated using one rollout in each of 100 parallel environments. All methods use identical evaluation configurations and trial budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过比较二元成功率，在八个桌面操作任务（图3）上评估了我们的方法。 进一步选择了四个代表性任务用于策略优化实验。 我们将分布内（ID）设置定义为原始数据收集分布所涵盖的任务配置，而分布外（OOD）设置则定义为该分布中不存在部署失败的情况。 在每种设置中，真实世界的性能通过20次试验进行测量，而模拟性能则使用100个并行环境中的每次单次运行进行评估。 所有方法均使用相同的评估配置和试验预算。

paragraphs.en: Our platform consists of a UR5e with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper and two Intel RealSense D435i cameras: a fixed third-person camera and a wrist-mounted camera. We initialize the policy from π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ) and fine-tune LoRA adapters using AdamW. Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is performed with FSDP on four NVIDIA H20 GPUs, using 32 samples per GPU. Policy refinement uses PPO with trainable LoRA adapters and a value head. Since H20 GPUs lack RT cores, two NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPUs run Isaac Lab and collect rollouts from 256 environments, while the H20 GPUs handle policy inference and optimization. The two sides communicate through a Ray cluster over SSH. PPO is trained for 200 update steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的平台由一台配备 Robotiq 2F-85 夹具的 UR5e 机器人和两台 Intel RealSense D435i 摄像头组成：一台固定的第三人称摄像头和一台安装在手腕上的摄像头。 我们从 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5}（Intelligence 等人，2025）初始化策略，并使用 AdamW 对 LoRA 适配器进行微调。 在四块 NVIDIA H20 GPU 上，我们使用 FSDP 执行监督微调（SFT），每块 GPU 使用 32 个样本。 策略优化采用 PPO 方法，并结合可训练的 LoRA 适配器和一个价值头。 由于 H20 GPU 缺少 RT 核心，因此由两块 NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU 运行 Isaac Lab 并从 256 个环境中收集轨迹数据，而 H20 GPU 则负责策略推理和优化。 这两侧通过 SSH 连接的 Ray 集群进行通信。 PPO 的训练持续 200 个更新步骤。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 evaluates F4R on failures encountered during real-world deployment. We compare against Targeted Behavior Cloning (Targeted BC), which collects corrective demonstrations from the real failure distribution, and RLinf-Co, which performs sim–real co-training followed by simulation RL. Targeted BC receives one hour of real-world data collection. RLinf-Co and F4R instead collect simulated experience for 10 minutes using 256 parallel environments, with the remaining 50 minutes accounting for reconstruction. In practice, scene reconstruction takes 25–30 minutes and object preparation takes 5–10 minutes. Importantly, scene reconstruction is a one-time setup. The reconstructed environment can be reused across subsequent failure-refinement cycles and only needs to be rebuilt when the physical workspace changes. Because task horizons vary, we match data-preparation time rather than trajectory count. RLinf-Co and F4R use identical architectures, training settings, and rollout budgets. Their only difference is the training distribution: RLinf-Co uses broad domain randomization, whereas F4R concentrates randomization around diagnosed failures.
paragraphs.zh: 表 1 评估了 F4R 在真实世界部署过程中遇到的故障表现。 我们将 F4R 与目标行为克隆（Targeted BC）以及 RLinf-Co 进行了对比：Targeted BC 从真实的故障分布中收集纠正性演示，而 RLinf-Co 则执行模拟-现实联合训练，随后进行模拟强化学习。 Targeted BC 需要一小时的时间来收集真实世界数据。 相比之下，RLinf-Co 和 F4R 使用 256 个并行环境收集 10 分钟的模拟经验，其余 50 分钟用于场景重建。 在实际操作中，场景重建需要 25–30 分钟，物体准备则需要 5–10 分钟。 重要的是，场景重建仅需一次初始设置。 重建后的环境可以在后续的故障优化循环中重复使用，只有当物理工作空间发生变化时才需要重新构建。 由于任务周期长度不同，我们以数据准备时间而非轨迹数量作为匹配标准。 RLinf-Co 和 F4R 使用了相同的架构、训练设置和策略迭代预算。 它们唯一的区别在于训练分布：RLinf-Co 采用广泛的领域随机化，而 F4R 则将随机化集中在已诊断出的故障周围。

paragraphs.en: Targeted BC achieves 91.25% success on the original distribution and 71.25% on the failure distribution, showing that corrective demonstrations are effective but require substantial real-world interaction. RLinf-Co improves failure-distribution success to 77.5%. Its training loss also converges, suggesting that the remaining gap is not caused by insufficient optimization. Instead, broad randomization may enlarge the sim-to-real gap and dilute training around relevant failures. By concentrating both trajectory generation and RL interaction on failure-relevant variations, F4R achieves 93.75% and 90.0% success on the original and failure distributions, respectively. It outperforms Targeted BC and RLinf-Co by 18.75 and 12.5 percentage points on the failure distribution.

paragraphs.en: The benefit is particularly clear on the multi-stage Place Block in Drawer task. Notably, when the drawer orientation differs from the original demonstrations, the base policy fails all closing attempts. This suggests that the supervised fine-tuned VLA model learns orientation-specific action patterns rather than transferable drawer kinematics. Targeted BC reaches 60% success, while RLinf-Co and F4R achieve 80% and 85%, respectively. These results highlight the value of simulation interaction for acquiring contact-sensitive behaviors that are difficult to capture with fixed demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 在“将物品放入抽屉”的多阶段任务中，这种优势尤为明显。 值得注意的是，当抽屉的方向与原始演示不同时，基础策略在所有关闭尝试中均会失败。 这表明，经过监督微调的 VLA 模型学习的是特定方向的行动模式，而非可迁移的抽屉运动学规律。 目标性行为克隆（Targeted BC）的成功率达到了 60%，而 RLinf-Co 和 F4R 分别达到了 80% 和 85%。 这些结果凸显了模拟交互在获取难以通过固定演示捕捉的接触敏感行为方面的价值。

paragraphs.en: A reconstructed environment is useful only if it preserves real-world behavioral trends. We evaluate this property across eight tabletop tasks with diverse objects and interaction complexities. For each task, we train policies using 10, 30, and 50 real-world demonstrations, yielding 24 checkpoints evaluated under matched configurations and success criteria in simulation and reality. This setup assesses whether reconstruction captures both task difficulty and performance gains from additional training data.
paragraphs.zh: 重建的环境只有在保留真实世界行为趋势的情况下才有用。 我们通过八个桌面任务来评估这一特性，这些任务涉及多样化的物体和不同复杂度的交互。 对于每个任务，我们使用 10、30 和 50 条真实世界的演示来训练策略，从而得到 24 个检查点，并在模拟和现实中以匹配的配置和成功标准进行评估。 这种设置旨在评估重建过程是否同时捕捉到了任务难度以及额外训练数据带来的性能提升。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate multi-round closed-loop refinement, we conduct three consecutive refinement cycles on two tasks. After each cycle, the refined policy is redeployed, and newly observed failures are used to guide the next round of reconstruction and training. As shown in Figure 4 , the success rate on Stack Bowls progressively increases from 30% to 80%, 90%, and 95%. This gradual improvement suggests that successive cycles address residual failure modes that remain after earlier refinements. On Pick Fruits , the first cycle raises performance from 40% to 100%, which is maintained throughout the next two cycles. The different convergence patterns indicate that F4R can support both gradual correction and rapid saturation, depending on task difficulty. Overall, these results show that F4R can continually address newly observed failures while preserving capabilities acquired in earlier rounds.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估多轮闭环优化，我们在两个任务上进行了三轮连续的优化循环。 每个循环结束后，优化后的策略都会被重新部署，而新观察到的失败则用于指导下一轮的重新构建与训练。 如图 4 所示，Stack Bowls 任务的成功率逐步从 30% 提升至 80%、90% 和 95%。 这种渐进式提升表明，连续循环能够解决早期优化后仍存在的残余失败模式。 在 Pick Fruits 任务中，第一轮循环将性能从 40% 提升至 100%，并在后续两轮循环中保持这一水平。 不同的收敛模式表明，F4R 能够根据任务难度支持渐进式修正或快速饱和。 总体而言，这些结果表明 F4R 能够在持续解决新观察到的失败的同时，保留早期轮次中获得的能力。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 isolates the contributions of the two policy-refinement stages. Removing Stage I leaves RL to optimize the base policy using simulated interaction and sparse task-success rewards, while retaining auxiliary supervision from the original real-world data. This variant improves the Base by only 13.75 percentage points under ID conditions and 6.25 points under OOD conditions, reaching 76.25% and 32.5%, respectively. The limited OOD improvement indicates that the base policy rarely discovers successful behaviors in severe failure regions through sparse-reward exploration alone. In contrast, Stage I co-training without subsequent RL achieves 90.0% ID and 83.75% OOD success, showing that failure-conditioned corrective demonstrations provide an effective initialization and account for most of the overall gain. Stage II RL further improves the co-trained policy by 3.75 and 6.25 points, yielding 93.75% ID and 90.0% OOD success. These results show that co-training addresses the primary failure modes and alleviates exploration difficulty, while RL further refines closed-loop behaviors beyond fixed demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 表 5 分别展示了两个策略优化阶段的贡献。 移除阶段 I 后，强化学习（RL）仅通过模拟交互和稀疏的任务成功奖励来优化基础策略，同时保留了原始真实世界数据提供的辅助监督。 在 ID 条件下，该变体仅将基础策略提升了 13.75 个百分点；在 OOD 条件下则提升了 6.25 个百分点，分别达到 76.25% 和 32.5%。 OOD 性能的提升有限表明，仅通过稀疏奖励的探索，基础策略很少能在严重的失败区域中发现成功行为。 相比之下，阶段 I 的联合训练（无需后续的 RL）在 ID 条件下实现了 90.0% 的成功率，在 OOD 条件下实现了 83.75% 的成功率，这说明以失败情况为条件的纠正性演示提供了有效的初始化，并贡献了大部分总体增益。 阶段 II 的强化学习进一步将联合训练后的策略提升了 3.75 和 6.25 个百分点，最终在 ID 条件下达到 93.75% 的成功率，在 OOD 条件下达到 90.0% 的成功率。 这些结果表明，联合训练解决了主要的失败模式并缓解了探索难度，而强化学习则进一步优化了超越固定演示的闭环行为。

sents.zh: 在 ID 条件下，该变体仅将基础策略提升了 13.75 个百分点；在 OOD 条件下则提升了 6.25 个百分点，分别达到 76.25% 和 32.5%。

sents.en: The limited OOD improvement indicates that the base policy rarely discovers successful behaviors in severe failure regions through sparse-reward exploration alone.
sents.zh: OOD 性能的提升有限表明，仅通过稀疏奖励的探索，基础策略很少能在严重的失败区域中发现成功行为。

sents.en: In contrast, Stage I co-training without subsequent RL achieves 90.0% ID and 83.75% OOD success, showing that failure-conditioned corrective demonstrations provide an effective initialization and account for most of the overall gain.
sents.zh: 相比之下，阶段 I 的联合训练（无需后续的 RL）在 ID 条件下实现了 90.0% 的成功率，在 OOD 条件下实现了 83.75% 的成功率，这说明以失败情况为条件的纠正性演示提供了有效的初始化，并贡献了大部分总体增益。

sents.en: Stage II RL further improves the co-trained policy by 3.75 and 6.25 points, yielding 93.75% ID and 90.0% OOD success.
sents.zh: 阶段 II 的强化学习进一步将联合训练后的策略提升了 3.75 和 6.25 个百分点，最终在 ID 条件下达到 93.75% 的成功率，在 OOD 条件下达到 90.0% 的成功率。

sents.en: These results show that co-training addresses the primary failure modes and alleviates exploration difficulty, while RL further refines closed-loop behaviors beyond fixed demonstrations.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，联合训练解决了主要的失败模式并缓解了探索难度，而强化学习则进一步优化了超越固定演示的闭环行为。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we present F4R, a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real framework that transforms deployment failures into targeted training opportunities. F4R employs an agent equipped with a dedicated failure discovery and diagnosis skill to analyze failed trajectories, reconstructs their task-relevant conditions in simulation, and refines the policy through failure-conditioned sim–real co-training followed by targeted RL. Real-world experiments demonstrate consistent improvements under both ID and OOD conditions, outperforming a budget-matched Targeted BC baseline while reducing reliance on additional real-world demonstrations. Multi-round refinement further shows that failures discovered after redeployment can guide subsequent updates, supporting continuous closed-loop improvement. These results establish deployment failures as practical signals for directing simulation generation and policy optimization. Future work will scale F4R to broader manipulation domains and investigate more efficient mechanisms to prioritize and reuse accumulated failure cases as deployment proceeds.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 F4R——一个以失败为驱动力的“真实-模拟-真实”框架，该框架将部署中的失败转化为有针对性的训练机会。 F4R 采用了一个配备专用失败发现与诊断能力的智能体，用于分析失败的轨迹，在模拟环境中重建与其任务相关的条件，并通过基于失败条件的模拟-真实协同训练以及后续的针对性强化学习来优化策略。 真实世界实验表明，F4R 在 ID 和 OOD 条件下均能持续改进，其表现优于预算相当的“针对性行为克隆”基线方法，同时减少了对额外真实世界演示数据的依赖。 多轮优化进一步表明，重新部署后发现的失败可以指导后续更新，从而支持持续性的闭环改进。 这些结果确立了部署失败作为指导模拟生成和策略优化的实用信号。 未来的工作将把 F4R 扩展到更广泛的操控领域，并研究更高效的方法，以在部署过程中优先处理并重复利用已积累的失败案例。

paragraphs.en: The event prompt states that the sample is a known failed trial, specifies the left/right view convention and frame headers, enumerates the allowed operations and failure types, and requests contains_failure_evidence , failure_frame_range , matched_labels , visible objects, target object, description, frame-grounded evidence, and confidence. paragraphs.en: The focused pass is part of every diagnosis rather than a stochastic resampling step. After the event calls screen all boards, only the earliest positive board is resubmitted with a narrower request for failure frame, target object, operation, and failure type. It does not add images, reorder the board, request reflection, or resample the interval. Per-window results, the state result, and the focused result are cached separately; --resume skips a completed sample, while an interrupted run reuses existing intermediate JSON. API transport or timeout errors repeat the identical request up to four times with waits of 5, 10, 15, and 20 seconds. These retries do not change the evidence or count as new diagnosis attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 聚焦步骤是每次诊断的一部分，而非随机重采样步骤。 事件调用检查所有面板后，仅将最早出现阳性结果的面板重新提交，并缩小对故障帧、目标对象、操作和故障类型的请求范围。 它不会添加图像、重新排列面板、请求反射或重采样时间间隔。 每个窗口的结果、状态结果和聚焦结果会分别缓存；--resume 会跳过已完成的重采样，而中断的运行则会复用现有的中间 JSON 数据。 如果发生 API 传输或超时错误，系统会将相同的请求重复最多四次，等待时间分别为 5、10、15 和 20 秒。 这些重试不会改变证据，也不会被计为新的诊断尝试。

paragraphs.en: The implementation is divided into deterministic preprocessing and cached VLM inference. The released commands first detect windows with stride 3, top-10 peaks, 120/180-frame context, and 240-frame suppression; then generate event and state boards; run GPT-5.5 inference; and export review and randomization records. The associated scripts and their default arguments are included in supplementary_assets/robot-video-failure-analyzer . Intermediate outputs are stored as event_windows.json , per-window storyboard manifests, cached JSON responses, a sample-level summary, a review CSV, and failure_conditioned_dr_v2.json . Responses are parsed as strict JSON; if surrounding text is returned, the first complete JSON object is recovered. Unparseable event responses are marked and cannot become the focused positive window. Returned labels are filtered against the configured candidate list before export.
paragraphs.zh: 该实现分为确定性预处理和缓存的 VLM 推理两个部分。 已发布的命令首先以步长 3、前 10 个峰值、120/180 帧上下文和 240 帧抑制检测窗口；然后生成事件和状态板；运行 GPT-5.5 推理；并导出审核和随机化记录。 相关脚本及其默认参数已包含在 supplementary_assets/robot-video-failure-analyzer 中。 中间输出存储为 event_windows.json、每个窗口的故事板清单、缓存的 JSON 响应、样本级摘要、审核 CSV 以及 failure_conditioned_dr_v2.json。 响应被解析为严格格式的 JSON；如果返回了周围文本，则会提取出第一个完整的 JSON 对象。 无法解析的事件响应会被标记，且不能成为聚焦的正向窗口。 返回的标签在导出前会与配置好的候选列表进行过滤。

paragraphs.en: We additionally evaluate multiple mainstream VLM backends on the public ViFailback benchmark ( Zeng et al., 2025 ) . All models receive the same storyboard input and prompt without benchmark-specific adaptation. This evaluation is separate from our 80-trajectory benchmark: ViFailback measures general failure attribution on a public dataset, whereas our benchmark uses task-specific dual-view rollouts and requires the joint prediction of failure stage and cause. Figure S4 reports the complete backend comparison.

paragraphs.en: To enable photorealistic simulation rendering while minimizing the manual effort required for environment reconstruction, we propose a Gaussian-based rendering and simulation coupling pipeline. Specifically, we employ 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) as the rendering frontend and Isaac Sim as the simulation backend. The robot appearance is represented by link-level Gaussian primitives, which are associated with the corresponding robot links and driven by the rigid transformations provided by the simulator. Fig. S5 illustrates the overall reconstruction and simulation integration workflow.

paragraphs.en: We first capture the target manipulation scene using an iPhone camera. During acquisition, the camera intrinsics remain fixed by locking the focal length and avoiding camera switching. The captured video is reconstructed into a photorealistic Gaussian representation using 3DGS. Since the reconstruction may contain irrelevant artifacts, such as floating Gaussians and robot cables, we perform a lightweight cleanup procedure to remove these components and isolate the robot-related Gaussians for subsequent alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先使用 iPhone 摄像头捕捉目标操控场景。 在采集过程中，通过锁定焦距并避免切换摄像头来保持相机内参不变。 利用 3DGS 将拍摄的视频重建为具有照片级真实感的高斯表示。 由于重建结果可能包含无关的伪影（例如漂浮的高斯分布和机器人电缆），因此我们执行一个轻量级的清理程序，以移除这些成分，并分离出与机器人相关的高斯分布，用于后续的配准。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, we import the robot model into Isaac Sim and initialize its configuration to match the real-world robot state. The local-to-world rigid transformations of all robot links are extracted from Isaac Sim and used to place the corresponding robot link meshes in the reconstructed scene. To establish geometric correspondence between the reconstructed robot Gaussians primitives and the simulated robot, we adopt a coarse-to-fine registration pipeline consisting of FPFH feature matching, RANSAC-based Sim3 estimation, and Sim3 ICP refinement. The Sim3 transformation compensates for the potential scale discrepancy between the reconstructed Gaussian representation and the simulator-defined robot geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，我们将机器人模型导入 Isaac Sim，并将其配置初始化为与真实世界中的机器人状态相匹配。 所有机器人连杆的局部到世界的刚体变换从 Isaac Sim 中提取，并用于在重建的场景中放置相应的机器人连杆网格。 为了在重建的机器人高斯原语与模拟机器人之间建立几何对应关系，我们采用了一种由粗到细的配准流程，包括 FPFH 特征匹配、基于 RANSAC 的 Sim3 估计以及 Sim3 ICP 优化。 Sim3 变换可以补偿重建的高斯表示与模拟器定义的机器人几何形状之间可能存在的尺度差异。

paragraphs.en: For object reconstruction, F4R supports two complementary approaches: (1) direct generation of simulation-ready assets from images and (2) geometric reconstruction from multi-view observations. Since image-based asset generation follows existing image-to-3D pipelines, we omit its implementation details and focus on the multi-view reconstruction approach adopted in our experiments. paragraphs.en: Each manipulated object is reconstructed from a COLMAP-style RGB-D dataset ( Schönberger and Frahm, 2016 ) collected by the wrist camera, including calibrated RGB images, metric depth maps, camera intrinsics, poses, and optional object masks. During preprocessing, the camera poses are converted from world-to-camera to base-to-camera transformations. To improve reconstruction accuracy, the depth maps can be refined using a learned depth estimator ( Tan et al., 2026 ) conditioned on RGB images, raw depth observations, and normalized camera intrinsics. The refined depth is constrained to a valid metric range and combined with object masks before being back-projected into camera-frame point clouds. These point clouds are voxel-downsampled and augmented with surface normals for subsequent registration.
paragraphs.zh: 每个被操控的物体都通过从手腕相机采集的 COLMAP 风格 RGB-D 数据集（Schönberger 和 Frahm，2016）进行重建，该数据集包括经过校准的 RGB 图像、度量深度图、相机内参、姿态以及可选的物体掩码。 在预处理阶段，相机姿态会从世界到相机的变换转换为基座到相机的变换。 为了提高重建精度，可以利用基于 RGB 图像、原始深度观测值以及归一化相机内参的深度学习深度估计器（Tan 等，2026）对深度图进行优化。 优化后的深度会被约束在有效的度量范围内，并与物体掩码结合后，再反向投影为相机坐标系下的点云。 这些点云会经过体素下采样，并为后续配准补充表面法线。

paragraphs.en: To obtain a consistent object geometry, neighboring observations are associated within a temporal window, and point correspondences are established through nearest-neighbor matching in the world coordinate system based on the initial robot poses. Camera poses are further optimized through a robust nonlinear optimization problem over SE(3), combining point-to-plane geometric alignment with a robot-pose prior that regularizes translation and rotation updates. With the optimized poses, masked TSDF fusion ( Curless and Levoy, 1996 ) produces a metric reconstruction, including a point cloud g i pcd g_{i}^{\mathrm{pcd}} and an initial mesh. The fused geometry is further denoised before asset generation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了获得一致的对象几何结构，需要在时间窗口内关联相邻的观测数据，并基于初始机器人位姿，在世界坐标系中通过最近邻匹配建立点云对应关系。 通过一个基于 SE(3) 的稳健非线性优化问题进一步优化相机位姿，该问题将点到平面的几何对齐与机器人位姿先验相结合，从而对平移和旋转更新进行正则化约束。 利用优化后的位姿，掩码 TSDF 融合（Curless 和 Levoy, 1996）可生成带有度量信息的重建结果，包括点云 g i pcd g_{i}^{\mathrm{pcd}} 和初始网格。 在生成资产之前，还需对融合后的几何结构进行进一步的去噪处理。

paragraphs.en: Four H20 GPUs perform policy inference and optimization, while two RTX 4090 GPUs run Isaac Lab 3.0 and collect rollouts. The nodes form a Ray cluster over SSH. Training is synchronous: each PPO iteration synchronizes the actor parameters, collects a complete rollout batch, and then updates the policy. Parameters are broadcast every iteration ( weight_sync_interval =1) and before evaluation. The scheduler and Arena subprocess queues are unbounded ( maxsize =0). paragraphs.en: A trial is counted as successful only when the task-specific goal condition is satisfied at the end of the episode and remains stable after robot release. For pick-and-place tasks, the manipulated object must be placed inside the target region without toppling or leaving the workspace. For stacking tasks, all bowls must remain stacked after release. For drawer tasks, the target object must be placed inside the drawer and the drawer state must remain within the task-defined valid range.
paragraphs.zh: 只有在回合结束时满足任务特定的目标条件，并且在机器人释放后该状态保持稳定时，一次试验才算成功。 对于抓取与放置任务，被操作的对象必须放置在目标区域内，且不能倾倒或离开工作空间。 对于堆叠任务，所有碗在释放后都必须保持堆叠状态。 对于抽屉任务，目标物体必须放置在抽屉内，并且抽屉的状态必须保持在任务定义的有效范围内。

For each task and evaluation setting, we report the success rate over 20 trials.

paragraphs.en: Targeted BC relies on human diagnosis of the observed failures and collects corrective demonstrations in the corresponding real-world failure distribution. It is allocated one hour of end-to-end real-world data-preparation time, including scene initialization, object rearrangement, environment resets, and preparation for repeated collection attempts. The allocated time excludes subsequent policy training. Targeted BC uses the same base policy, LoRA configuration, and SFT procedure as F4R.
paragraphs.zh: 目标行为克隆依赖人类对观察到的故障的诊断，并在相应的真实世界故障分布中收集纠正性演示。 它被分配了一个小时的端到端真实世界数据准备时间，包括场景初始化、物体重新排列、环境重置以及为重复收集尝试所做的准备。 所分配的时间不包括后续的策略训练。 目标行为克隆使用与 F4R 相同的基策略、LoRA 配置和 SFT 流程。

paragraphs.en: RLinf-Co ( Shi et al., 2026 ) performs sim–real co-training followed by simulation-based RL. To isolate the effect of failure-aware randomization, RLinf-Co and F4R use the same policy architecture, real-world training data, simulator assets, optimization hyperparameters, update schedule, number of parallel environments, and rollout budget. They differ only in the construction of the simulated training distribution: RLinf-Co applies broad, task-level domain randomization, whereas F4R concentrates randomization around failure modes diagnosed from real-world deployments.
paragraphs.zh: RLinf-Co（Shi 等人，2026）执行模拟-现实协同训练，随后进行基于模拟的强化学习。 为了单独分析失败感知随机化的影响，RLinf-Co 和 F4R 使用了相同的策略架构、真实世界训练数据、模拟器资产、优化超参数、更新计划、并行环境数量以及 rollout 预算。 它们仅在模拟训练分布的构建方式上存在差异：RLinf-Co 采用宽泛的任务级领域随机化，而 F4R 则将随机化集中在从真实世界部署中诊断出的失败模式周围。

sents.zh: RLinf-Co（Shi 等人，2026）执行模拟-现实协同训练，随后进行基于模拟的强化学习。

paragraphs.en: We match all methods by an end-to-end data-preparation wall-clock budget rather than by trajectory count. Targeted BC is allocated one hour for real-world data collection, including scene initialization, object rearrangement, environment resets, and preparation for repeated collection attempts. RLinf-Co and F4R are each allocated the same one-hour budget: 50 minutes for method-specific preparation and 10 minutes for parallel simulated rollout collection. For F4R, preparation includes failure diagnosis, scene and object reconstruction, simulator integration, and validation. For RLinf-Co, the same allowance covers simulator and object-asset construction, configuration of broad domain randomization, integration, and validation. Scene reconstruction typically requires 25–30 minutes, while preparing a new object asset requires 5–10 minutes; the remaining time is used for integration and validation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据端到端的数据准备实际耗时来匹配所有方法，而不是根据轨迹数量。 目标行为克隆（Targeted BC）被分配一小时用于真实世界的数据收集，包括场景初始化、物体重新布置、环境重置以及为重复收集尝试做准备。 RLinf-Co 和 F4R 各自被分配相同的一小时预算：50 分钟用于方法特定的准备，10 分钟用于并行模拟运行数据收集。 对于 F4R，准备工作包括故障诊断、场景与物体重建、模拟器集成以及验证。 对于 RLinf-Co，相同的预算涵盖模拟器与物体资产的构建、广泛领域随机化的配置、集成以及验证。 场景重建通常需要 25–30 分钟，而准备一个新的物体资产则需要 5–10 分钟；剩余时间用于集成和验证。

paragraphs.en: The reconstructed scene is a reusable asset and only needs to be updated when the physical workspace changes. When only the manipulated object changes, the scene is reused and only a new object asset is prepared. Because task horizons and parallel collection produce different numbers of trajectories, we control for data-preparation time rather than trajectory count.

paragraphs.en: F4R improves OOD success by 18.75 percentage points over Targeted BC and 12.5 points over RLinf-Co. The largest distinction is not simply additional optimization: RLinf-Co uses an identical optimization and rollout budget but spreads interaction across broad variations. Failure diagnosis instead concentrates F4R’s data generation and RL interaction on deployment-relevant weaknesses.
paragraphs.zh: F4R 在 OOD 成功率上比 Targeted BC 提高了 18.75 个百分点，比 RLinf-Co 提高了 12.5 个百分点。 最大的区别并不仅仅是额外的优化：RLinf-Co 使用了相同的优化和部署预算，但将交互分散到了广泛的变体中。 相比之下，故障诊断将 F4R 的数据生成和 RL 交互集中在与部署相关的弱点上。

paragraphs.en: For each of eight tasks, we train policies using 10, 30, and 50 real-world demonstrations, yielding 24 checkpoints. Each checkpoint is evaluated under matched configurations and success criteria in simulation and the real world. The resulting success rates exhibit a strong positive correlation ( r = 0.7625 r=0.7625 , p = 1.49 × 10 − 5 p=1.49\times 10^{-5} ), showing that the reconstructed environments preserve both broad task difficulty and performance changes induced by additional data. Table S20 reports all checkpoint values.
paragraphs.zh: 对于八项任务中的每一项，我们使用 10、30 和 50 个真实世界的演示来训练策略，从而得到 24 个检查点。 每个检查点都在匹配的配置和成功标准下，于模拟环境和真实世界中进行评估。 由此得到的成功率表现出强烈的正相关关系（r = 0.7625 r=0.7625，p = 1.49 × 10 − 5 p=1.49\times 10^{-5}），表明重建的环境既保留了任务的整体难度，也保留了额外数据所引发的性能变化。 表 S20 报告了所有检查点的数值。

paragraphs.en: We conduct three consecutive refinement cycles on Stack Bowls and Pick Fruits. After each cycle, the updated policy is redeployed and newly observed failures are fed into the next diagnosis and refinement cycle. Stack Bowls improves from 30 % 30\% to 80 % 80\% , 90 % 90\% , and 95 % 95\% . Pick Fruits improves from 40 % 40\% to 100 % 100\% in the first cycle and maintains this performance in later evaluations. These results show that F4R can address residual failures while retaining capabilities acquired in earlier rounds. Table S21 details each cycle.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对“堆叠碗”和“采摘水果”任务进行了三轮连续的优化循环。 每轮循环结束后，更新后的策略都会被重新部署，而新观察到的失败案例会被输入到下一轮的诊断与优化循环中。 “堆叠碗”任务的准确率从 30 % 30\% 提升至 80 % 80\%、90 % 90\% 和 95 % 95\%。 “采摘水果”任务在第一轮循环中从 40 % 40\% 提升至 100 % 100\%，并在后续评估中保持这一表现。 这些结果表明，F4R 能够在保留早期阶段所获得能力的同时，解决遗留的失败问题。 表 S21 详细记录了每一轮循环的情况。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure S10 , the success rate on Fruit-to-Basket increases from 65% to 100% after the first cycle and remains near saturation at 95% after the second. On Cup-on-Coaster , performance initially decreases from 60% to 50%, indicating that a single targeted update may expose or introduce failure modes not covered by the current training distribution. Feeding these failures into the second cycle raises the success rate to 90%. Overall, the average success rate increases from 62.5% to 92.5% after two cycles, demonstrating that F4R can repeatedly convert deployment feedback into further policy improvement.

paragraphs.en: Our current evaluation focuses on tabletop manipulation with predominantly rigid objects. The method has not yet been validated on deformable objects, dynamic scenes, mobile manipulation, or long-horizon assembly. Scaling to many objects and accumulated failures also requires strategies for merging, prioritizing, and retiring failure distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们当前的评估主要集中在对以刚性物体为主的桌面操作上。 该方法尚未在可变形物体、动态场景、移动操作或长期装配任务中得到验证。 扩展到多物体处理以及应对累积失败，还需要制定合并、优先处理和淘汰失败分布的策略。

paragraphs.en: During real-robot deployment, a human operator remains available for emergency stop and hardware safety, but does not diagnose failures or provide corrective demonstrations for F4R. Rollouts terminate on timeout, communication loss, detected collision, or other abnormal conditions. By shifting repeated failure correction to simulation, F4R reduces the number of potentially risky real-world retries.
paragraphs.zh: 在实际机器人部署过程中，人类操作员仍可在紧急情况下进行停机操作并确保硬件安全，但不会诊断故障或为 F4R 提供纠正性演示。 在超时、通信中断、检测到碰撞或其他异常情况下，执行流程将终止。 通过将重复的故障纠正过程转移至模拟环境，F4R 减少了可能具有风险的现实世界中的重试次数。
